text.hi: Pythagoras Theorem se hum right triangle ki missing side nikaal sakte hain — construction, navigation, aur physics mein hota hai. Board exams mein har saal aata hai!
text.en: The Pythagoras Theorem lets us find a right triangle's missing side — used in construction, navigation, and physics. It appears in board exams every year!

content.hi: Theorem: Right triangle mein hypotenuse ka square baaki do sides ke squares ke sum ke barabar hota hai.
content.en: Theorem: In a right triangle, the square of the hypotenuse equals the sum of squares of the other two sides.

content.hi: Hypotenuse = right angle ke saamne wali sabse badi side. Base aur Perpendicular = right angle banane wali do sides.
content.en: Hypotenuse = the largest side, opposite the right angle. Base and Perpendicular = the two sides forming the right angle.

content.hi: Pythagorean triplets: 3,4,5 | 5,12,13 | 8,15,17 | 7,24,25 — inke multiples bhi triplets hote hain (6,8,10 ya 9,12,15).
content.en: Pythagorean triplets: 3,4,5 | 5,12,13 | 8,15,17 | 7,24,25 — their multiples are also triplets (like 6,8,10 or 9,12,15).

problem.hi: Right triangle mein legs 8cm aur 15cm hain. Hypotenuse nikaalo.
problem.en: In a right triangle, the two legs are 8cm and 15cm. Find the hypotenuse.

problem.hi: Right triangle mein hypotenuse 25cm, ek side 7cm. Doosri side nikaalo.
problem.en: In a right triangle, hypotenuse is 25cm, one side is 7cm. Find the other side.

problem.hi: 10,24,26 cm ke sides wala triangle right triangle hai kya?
problem.en: Check whether a triangle with sides 10cm, 24cm, 26cm is a right triangle.

problem.hi: 13m ki ladder, wall pe 12m height tak pahunchti hai. Ladder ki wall se distance nikaalo.
problem.en: A 13m ladder reaches a window 12m above ground. Find the distance of the foot of the ladder from the wall.

question.en: Which of the following is a Pythagorean triplet?

question.hi: Ek ped toot kar zameen se 6m dur touch karta hai. Toota hua part 10m hai. Original height?
question.en: A tree breaks and touches ground 6m from base. Broken part is 10m. Find original height.

explanation.hi: Standing part: x²+6²=10² → x=8. Original height=8+10=18m.
explanation.en: Standing part: x²+6²=10² → x=8. Original height=8+10=18m.

question.hi: Agar a²+b²=c² ho, to triangle hamesha right-angled hota hai.
question.en: If a²+b²=c², the triangle is always right-angled.

explanation.en: This is the converse of the Pythagoras theorem.

summary.hi: Pythagoras theorem se right triangle ki koi bhi missing side nikaal sakte ho, aur converse se check kar sakte ho ki triangle right-angled hai ya nahi.
summary.en: The Pythagoras theorem finds any missing side of a right triangle, and its converse checks whether a triangle is right-angled.
